scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified all required information. The path to get there was somewhat inefficient — the initial assembly_conflicts tool returned nothing, errors tool produced oversized output twice, and file reading attempts failed. But the agent recovered well using binlog_search and binlog_diagnose to ultimately get the right answer. The final output is clear, accurate, and includes helpful fix suggestions.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict
